capabilities: Run code blocks in place with output, plots and animations shown under the block
Debug Python with breakpoints, stepping, hover values and a variables view
Share one Python or MATLAB session across blocks in a note and install missing packages on failure
Export notes as .ipynb, .py or .m files and import notebooks and scripts as notes
Explain failed blocks with Apple Intelligence, Ollama or Claude and apply suggested fixes
extras: Runs programs on your computer with your user account's permissions, so only run code you trust. Developed and tested on macOS; Windows and Linux support is written but untested. Python on iPhone and iPad is beta and needs a one-time ~13.5 MB Pyodide download. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian code blocks are static text; there is no built-in way to execute them, see their output, or keep a shared session across blocks in a note.

relations.evidence: export a note as a .ipynb notebook (with its outputs and plots)
Python blocks also run on iPhone and iPad, with Pyodide (Python 3.14 built for the web)
Python and MATLAB blocks get suggestions from the running session

requires.name: Language toolchains (Python, MATLAB, compilers, interpreters) for desktop execution
Anthropic API key for the Claude explain-error option

summary: Notebook-style code runner that executes code blocks in place, with a Python kernel, debugger, variables view, MATLAB sessions and about 25 other languages.
